import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int[][] largestLocal(int[][] grid){int n=grid.length;int[][] out=new int[n-2][n-2];for(int i=1;i<n-1;i++)for(int j=1;j<n-1;j++){int m=Integer.MIN_VALUE;for(int x=i-1;x<=i+1;x++)for(int y=j-1;y<=j+1;y++)m=Math.max(m,grid[x][y]);out[i-1][j-1]=m;}return out;} }

import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int minimumRecolors(String blocks,int k){int black=0;for(int i=0;i<k;i++)if(blocks.charAt(i)=='B')black++;int best=k-black;for(int i=k;i<blocks.length();i++){if(blocks.charAt(i)=='B')black++;if(blocks.charAt(i-k)=='B')black--;best=Math.min(best,k-black);}return best;} }
complexity_reason: The window is updated in constant time for each character.

import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int minNumberOfHours(int initialEnergy,int initialExperience,int[] energy,int[] experience){int need=Math.max(0,Arrays.stream(energy).sum()+1-initialEnergy);int exp=initialExperience;for(int e:experience){if(exp<=e){need+=e-exp+1;exp=e+1;}exp+=e;}return need;} }

import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int mostFrequentEven(int[] nums){Map<Integer,Integer> f=new HashMap<>();for(int x:nums)if(x%2==0)f.put(x,f.getOrDefault(x,0)+1);int ans=-1,best=0;for(var e:f.entrySet())if(e.getValue()>best||(e.getValue()==best&&(ans==-1||e.getKey()<ans))){ans=e.getKey();best=e.getValue();}return ans;} }

import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int hardestWorker(int n,int[][] logs){int id=logs[0][0],best=logs[0][1],prev=logs[0][1];for(int i=1;i<logs.length;i++){int emp=logs[i][0],end=logs[i][1],d=end-prev;if(d>best||(d==best&&emp<id)){best=d;id=emp;}prev=end;}return id;} }
